page.notes: Gutter numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are printed at the left edge of the right page's text; placed as line markers in the right column. Several titles are abbreviated or hard to read (e.g. "Cöcio de Cœna", "Dragmata", "Nordlingiacensem", "Ad Theobal."); a few words in the right column are doubtful but were read as printed. The line "Sermo de in'ercessione" was read as "intercessione". Page is set in roman with Greek in "παράδοξον" (left page, Didascalica entry). The left page's last word "resurrectio-" continues as "nis" on the right page.
